# Mission Trip Planning: guides, checklists and costs for churches

> Practical, free guides for church missions teams planning a short-term mission
> trip: step-by-step planning, a full checklist, real cost ranges and a budget
> calculator, packing lists, fundraising ideas, team recruiting, and how to find
> and vet a mission partner. Written for gospel centered trips where the
> spiritual preparation of the team matters as much as the logistics. The
> optional software behind it is GO by MKDSCPLS, which is free for up to 5 trips
> with no platform fees.

This site is a planning resource first. Churches usually arrive while planning a
trip, not while shopping for software.

## Planning guides
- [How to plan a mission trip](https://missiontripplanning.com/how-to-plan-a-mission-trip): The full step-by-step process for organizing a church mission trip, from first decision to departure.
- [Mission trip checklist](https://missiontripplanning.com/checklist): Step-by-step timeline from 12 months out to trip launch. What to prepare and when.
- [Mission trip budget and cost calculator](https://missiontripplanning.com/budget): What a mission trip actually costs. Real ranges for domestic and international trips, including airfare, lodging, in-country transport, visas, travel insurance, immunizations and tipping, with a calculator to estimate a total group cost.
- [Mission trip packing list](https://missiontripplanning.com/mission-trip-packing-list): What to bring. Documents, clothing, toiletries, ministry materials, health and first aid. Free printable.

## Funding the trip
- [Mission trip fundraising ideas](https://missiontripplanning.com/mission-trip-fundraising-ideas): 30 ways to fund a trip, including support letters, team fundraisers and sponsorship, for individuals and whole teams.

## Building and sending the team
- [Filling your team](https://missiontripplanning.com/filling-your-team): How to recruit and select the right people for a church mission trip.
- [Church mission partners](https://missiontripplanning.com/church-mission-partners): How churches find, vet and work with reliable international mission trip partners and in-country hosts, and what to ask before committing a team.

## Choosing software, if you need it
- [Compare mission trip management software](https://missiontripplanning.com/compare): How GO compares with other mission trip management platforms, including Managed Missions and ServiceReef. Features, pricing and platform fees.
- [Features](https://missiontripplanning.com/features): Trip management, fundraising, donor tracking, applications, e-signatures.
- [Pricing](https://missiontripplanning.com/pricing): Free for up to 5 trips and offline giving. No platform fee at any tier.
- [Home](https://missiontripplanning.com/): What mission trip planning software does and why the base plan is free.

## Get started
- [What setting up a trip involves](https://missiontripplanning.com/start): The three steps of moving a trip onto GO, what the free plan covers (5 trips, offline giving, no platform fee on donations at any tier), when a church would pay, and when the software is not worth it for a single small trip.
- [Start free](https://go.mkdscpls.com/get-started): Create your church's mission trip on GO by MKDSCPLS.
